actions: Conduct a thorough field scouting walk this week to identify any signs of disease (anthracnose, powdery mildew) or pest (fruit fly, mealybug) pressure.
Apply a balanced foliar fertilizer (e.g., NPK 10:10:10 at 200 kg/ha) to address potential nutrient deficiencies indicated by low canopy vigor.
Implement erosion control measures: apply a 5‑cm layer of organic mulch around the tree base and install contour bunds on sloping areas to reduce runoff.
Maintain the existing drip‑irrigation schedule (every 7‑10 days) and verify uniform water delivery to all trees.
If disease symptoms are observed, treat promptly with appropriate fungicides as per the crop knowledge engine recommendations.
Record all observations and interventions in a farm log for future reference.
